subject: Contingency switch controls for canary (SLA impact) - authorization request
messages:
From: Michael Carter <michael.carter@novacorp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@novacorp.com, sre@novacorp.com
Date: 2026-09-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: contingency switch controls for canary (SLA impact)

Hi Jasmine,

We're preparing the NovaCorp integration rollout next week and procurement has flagged a hard SLA requirement for 99.95% uptime and 95th percentile latency <= 200ms. Our internal SREs (cc'd) want explicit mitigation controls during the canary to avoid contractual breach if we see latency regressions from the new variant.

Specifically, we'd like Redwood to:
- Configure an automatic fallback to the last-stable model variant when 95th percentile latency for this tenant exceeds 200ms for a sustained 5-minute window, OR error rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes.
- Pin the fallback variant for a temporary window (we prefer 48 hours) while we triage, with the option to extend only by mutual written agreement.
- Surface a canary telemetry snapshot (latency, 5xx rate, token cost delta) to our SRE channel and to the contract team for any rollback decision.

Attached is our SLA matrix for reference (nova_sla_matrix.csv). Contracts needs a technical attestation from Redwood that these measures are enforceable and that we can get a short-term exception to rollout policy for this account. Can you confirm what you need from our side to proceed and route this for internal approval?

Thanks,
Michael Carter
VP of Platform Engineering
NovaCorp

Attachments: nova_sla_matrix.csv
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Carter <michael.carter@novacorp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: contingency switch controls for canary (SLA impact)

Thanks Michael — that’s clear and totally reasonable to request for a customer of this size. I pulled a first-pass proposal for the contingency controls and the operational flow. Attaching proposed_canary_policy.yaml with the exact thresholds and actions. Highlights below: 

- Trigger conditions (any one):
  * 95th pct latency > 200ms for 5 consecutive minutes (region=us)
  * Request error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 5 minutes
  * Token cost delta > 25% coupled with latency regression (signal quality check)
- Action:
  * Immediate traffic switch to last-stable model variant for this tenant (auto-fallback).
  * Apply a temporary pin to the last-stable variant for 48 hours. Pin is implemented as a tenant-scoped override (redwood.pin.tenant: true).
  * Generate a telemetry snapshot and post to NovaCorp SRE webhook + upload to the account Drive folder.
- Safety & governance:
  * A human review step is required before extending pin beyond 72 hours (manual approval from Redwood account lead + NovaCorp SRE).
  * All automated switches are recorded in the audit log and surfaced in the Redwood Console per-route timeline.

Operational notes / questions:
- Do you need the fallback to act at a region-level only or should we allow per-pod granularity?
- Contracts: we can provide a short attestation email and a Docusign stub for the exception once internal approvals are done.

Lauren / Aditya / Marissa — can I get quick OKs on the thresholds and the 48h pin window? If we’re good, I’ll open the exception request and route the Docusign for formal signoff. I’ve included the proposed yaml as an attachment.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed_canary_policy.yaml
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Michael Carter <michael.carter@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T17:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: contingency switch controls for canary (SLA impact)

On Sep 12, 2026, at 11:03, Jasmine Liu wrote:
> Lauren / Aditya / Marissa — can I get quick OKs on the thresholds and the 48h pin window? If we’re good, I’ll open the exception request and route the Docusign for formal signoff.

I reviewed the proposed policy. Approve conditionally with two changes:
1) If an error signal appears at low traffic (<=25%), require an automated pause at 25% traffic instead of immediate full pin — this gives us a chance to validate/triage without full customer impact.
2) Any pin extension beyond 72 hours requires Legal & Risk signoff (we must not create an open-ended SLA carveout).

Marissa, please loop in the Risk team to expedite the contract attestation once Jasmine sends the Docusign.

I'll mark this approved for engineering to implement the guardrails and automation.

-Lauren

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Carter <michael.carter@novacorp.com>, contracts@novacorp.com
Date: 2026-09-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: contingency switch controls for canary (SLA impact) — Implementation & confirmation

Ack — engineering will implement the policy as discussed. Summary of what I’m pushing now:
- Canary guard configured for tenant: novacorp (region=us).
- Triggers: 95p latency >200ms for 5m OR 5xx >0.5% for 5m (as in proposed yaml).
- Initial action: failover to last-stable variant with tenant-scoped pin for 48 hours. If traffic <=25% when signal fires, system pauses at 25% traffic and notifies SRE channel (per Lauren).
- Audit events and telemetry snapshots will be published to the Drive folder and to the HubSpot deal activity.
- Docusign request has been created for the exception (link below). Once Michael signs we’ll mark the exception active and apply the tenant override.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/records/XYZ-9882
Infra flag created: redwood.contingency.novacorp = true

Forwarding confirmation to NovaCorp: the automation is in place and we can enable the exception on receipt of signed DocuSign. I’ve attached the signed stub once Legal signs (docusign_canary_approval.pdf).

Thanks everyone — will monitor first 24h closely and post telemetry.

- Aditya Rao
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
